name: B10-0333/2025 (Renew) – Case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking the United Arab Emirates to free Ryan Cornelius, a British businessman held in Dubai since 2008, and all other people it says are held unfairly. It also asks the United Arab Emirates to sign up to two international human rights treaties, and asks the European Commission to make a planned partnership agreement with the country depend on that.

- No law changes; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects Ryan Cornelius, other detainees, and the United Arab Emirates government.
- Next, the text goes to the United Arab Emirates, the Commission and other bodies.
